notes.text:
This update for netpbm fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2018-8975: The pm_mallocarray2 function allowed remote attackers to cause
  a denial of service (heap-based buffer over-read) via a crafted image file
  (bsc#1086777).

notes.text: The pm_mallocarray2 function in lib/util/mallocvar.c in Netpbm through 10.81.03 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (heap-based buffer over-read) via a crafted image file, as demonstrated by pbmmask.
